title: Senior Scientist, AI — Gartner
subtitle: Agentic AI for client-call intelligence at Gartner scale — graph-based re-architecture, local model hosting, and evaluation.

projects.name: Call Insights at Scale
projects.html: the foundation — an LLM-as-classifier/extractor pipeline that summarizes calls and pulls out contextual insight: client objections and how associates handle them, associate effectiveness, which handling methods work best against which objections, and whether the client is engaging or disengaging — feeding the structured insights and call-transcript chunks into a knowledge graph.

projects.name: GraphGOAT
projects.html: grew that insight graph into a full re-architecture of Gartner's agentic tech (GOAT) around a single knowledge graph — unifying the data behind post-call follow-ups, quarterly business reviews and asset-intelligence agents so the agent only writes a graph query and summarizes, instead of doing multi-step reasoning itself. Cut context ~200–250K → <15K tokens per query, per-query reasoning 10–15 steps → 2–3, and agentic errors ~20% — while opening far wider connected-data access, across 30–50K calls/month.

projects.name: Local LLM migration
projects.html: fine-tuned and self-hosted a Gemma-4 12B model on AWS SageMaker (L4 GPU) — replacing the Azure OpenAI GPT-5.4 calls the pipeline relied on. With speculative (multi-token) decoding and TurboQuant near-lossless 4-bit KV-cache quantization: decode latency ~−50%, throughput ~+50% — matching cloud-API speed at no per-call cost.

projects.name: Agent performance & evaluation engineering
projects.html: TOON + Markdown I/O (−22% latency, −35% tokens), prompt caching, model routing, DSPy for model-invariant prompts, and RL-based feedback with LLM eval suites.

stack: Stack: LangGraph · Neo4j · Gemma-4 · AWS SageMaker · DSPy
